title: Enhancement: Show G6 transmitter age
body:
Actually, AAPS keeps track of the G6 **sensor** age. It would be helpful to keep track of the **transmitter age** too.

I don't know if _transmitter change_ info is transferred from BYODA/xDrip or needs to be entered in AAPS...

xDrip gives the transmitter **age** but BYODA only gives **the date** when it was started

comments.body:
BOYDA doesn't send this info.
you may request it then we can implement it

@MilosKozak Why not add a button in AAPS for _Transmitter activation_ ?
